ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing alt of the C1-1,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown ov Map No. 12-T in

the area bound by:

a line 50 feet east of and parallel to the alley next east of and parallel to South Kedzie
Avenue; West 51st Street; South Sacramento Avenue; and the alley next south of and

parallel to West 51st Street,
to those of a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
